submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 75 (Cr0.10 Fe0.41 V0.49) gave the highest EQE: 0.194%. I chose it because I expected a FeVO4-type phase (Fe:V near 1:1, bandgap around 2.7 eV) with little Cr to work best under 2.72 eV light. Compared with 75, adding more Cr (index 99) or more Fe (index 91) both lowered EQE.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.159%. More Cr (0.25) at the same V fraction lowered it.
Measured EQE 0.160%. Moving to more Fe than V (Fe 0.50, V 0.41) lowered it.
The GP suggested it, but its predicted mean (0.135%) was below the best value already measured. With one measurement left, I tested the low-Cr, Fe-rich direction instead.
